name: Diffusion-Based Guidance for Radiance Field Optimization
definition: Computes a gradient signal from a frozen Stable Diffusion model to optimize an input image or latent by predicting noise, applying classifier-free guidance, and backpropagating the difference between predicted and actual noise.
summary: Diffusion-Based Guidance for Radiance Field Optimization uses a frozen 2D diffusion model to guide 3D scene optimization, distinguishing itself by relying on a pre-trained prior rather than learned multi-view consistency networks.
